source: Benneke et al. 2019, Nature Astronomy (arXiv 1907.00449), brightness temperature from ten eclipses fitted together, detected at 4.7 sigma (Methods, secondary eclipse analysis). the paper's 3.6 µm value (+33, -39 K; the larger is kept); at 4.5 µm the same paper gives only an upper limit, under 532 K, so the two bands disagree. https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.00449
